narr: An upper trough pulled up stationary across Northeast Texas, extreme Southern Arkansas and North Louisiana during the morning of August 18th, which reinforced a weak surface front south into Deep East Texas and Central Louisiana. This front focused an area of low level moisture pooling across these areas, as well as increased large scale forcing as it tapped into strong heating during the afternoon. Weak steering currents were noted aloft, resulting in an area of slow moving thunderstorms developing across Southern Cherokee and much of Angelina Counties in Deep East Texas, with widespread rainfall amounts of two to four inches falling across these areas in a short period of time. Thus, flash flooding was observed in Downtown Lufkin in Angelina County where a couple of roads were covered in high water.
ev: The intersection of Jefferson Avenue and Raguet Street in Downtown Lufkin was flooded.
lsr: FLOODING REPORTED ON JEFFERSON AVENUE AND RAGUET STREET IN LUFKIN.
